class.name: litearm_ros2_control/LitearmSystem
class.description: ros2_control system hardware interface for the seven-axis litearm arm. The plugin does not access USB/CAN directly: it exchanges commands and joint states with a Python daemon (litearm_hw_daemon, which owns the USB CDC link to the litearm-stm32 firmware) through shared memory protected by a seqlock, so read()/write() are lock-free memcpy and no Python runs in the real-time loop.
